Vibe Coding vs Spec Coding — What's the Difference?

Vibe coding got you a demo. It won't get you to prod.
Vibe coding is prompt, prompt, prompt until something works.
Spec coding documents requirements and design first, so the AI builds toward a validated plan.
Kiro supports both — but pushes you toward the second for anything real.
